items.before: The reason page's heading and browser title, its task on the overview and its card on the review now all read 'Main import reason', in English and Welsh.
items.after:
These now all read 'Main import reason':

- the reason page's heading
- the reason page's browser title
- its task on the overview
- its card on the review

This applies in English and Welsh.

items.before: Each destination country and port of exit dropdown on the reason page now starts with 'Select one', followed straight by the list with no divider line. They stay plain dropdowns, without type-ahead search, in this release.
items.after:
Each destination country and port of exit dropdown on the reason page now starts with 'Select one'.

The list follows straight after it, with no divider line.

They stay plain dropdowns in this release. They do not get type-ahead search.

items.before: The certification question on additional details now has the hint 'You can find this information on the ITAHC.' The review keeps reading these answers back as 'Certified for' and 'Includes unweaned animals'.
items.after:
The certification question on additional details now has this hint:

'You can find this information on the ITAHC.'

The review still reads these answers back as:

- 'Certified for'
- 'Includes unweaned animals'

items.before: Before, the main import reason task waited for the additional details answers too. Now it shows Complete once the reason and its follow-up answers are given, and additional details is its own task.
items.after:
Before, the main import reason task also waited for the additional details answers.

Now it shows Complete once the reason and its follow-up answers are given.

Additional details is its own task.

items.before: Saving a different reason, including with 'Save and return to overview', now clears the follow-up answers given for the old one: switching from Internal market to Transit drops the saved purpose. Pressing 'Save and return to overview' with no reason chosen keeps everything saved before.
items.after:
Saving a different reason now clears the follow-up answers given for the old one.

This includes saving with 'Save and return to overview'.

For example, switching from Internal market to Transit drops the saved purpose.

Selecting 'Save and return to overview' with no reason chosen keeps everything saved before.
